text:
Let me share this in Capampangan lyrics translated by my Ingcung (grandfather) Rey Maniago and was sang by my brother-in-law Rommel Barrameda at our Ingcung and Apu’s golden wedding anniversary celebration. It was one of the highlights of that day.. 💕🥹

IKA AMPO YAKU ✨
IKAW AT AKO by Johnoy Danao
Translated in Capampangan by Rey Maniago

Ika ampo yaku pitagmu
Misabi la ding pusu
Mikasundung miabe angga king angga

Mipanyumpa arap ning Ginu
Ikata kaleldo o kauran
Arapan ing nanu mang dumalan a bagyu

E sana malumpawi ing lugud
Masakit gawan, mayan sabyan
Keng yatung alang kapilmian
Agnan tang gawan bukas ing milabas

Ika ampo yaku pisanmetung
Atin katang sara-sarili
Sasandal keng balang metung

Abutan ta ing nanu mang nasa
Arapan ta ing nanu mang takut
Ikatang adua kapilan pa man

Neng misan e ku asasabi
Ing lugud ku e masukad keng nanu pa man
Nung menamdaman ka keng pamagkamali ku
Agyu mu ku kayang patawaran

E ku balu ing gawan ku nung ala ka
Ating kabaldugan ing biye ku
Patie kaulan mu ku’t uman
Miras kata man keng kapupusan ning biye
Pusung matalik da kang idaun Kaya
Ngeni ampon kapilan pa man
Ika ampo yaku…

“NO COPYRIGHT INFRINGEMENT INTENDED. THESE LYRICS IS FOR ENTERTAINMENT ONLY.”
